closed_findings.economic_impact: A group-only proxy would manufacture an avoidable white-goods boundary error and overstate the Enhanced method's utility.
closed_findings.missing_fact_or_control: A realistic minimum baseline using direct product evidence and an equal research budget.
closed_findings.prohibited_assumption: An investor who can see the white-goods product row would rationally ignore it and promote group trends to product execution.
closed_findings.remediation: The Baseline now uses white-goods revenue and gross margin, group cash and leverage as background, a group/product divergence guard, and the same three-hour budget as Enhanced.
closed_findings.acceptance_criterion: A group/product direction divergence mechanically resolves to WHITE_GOODS_UNKNOWN and cannot receive AVOIDED_ERROR.

closed_findings.economic_impact: Caller-authored labels or an unexecuted narrative rule could create a false method advantage after outcome access.
closed_findings.missing_fact_or_control: Executable method rules, canonical settlement label derivation and a shared decision-treatment materiality test.
closed_findings.prohibited_assumption: Finding more dimensions, a scope event or a rival is itself an avoided error or material improvement.
closed_findings.remediation: resolve_method_outputs now derives both methods and paired utility from the full frozen label vector; the receipt derives labels from an ordered canonical settlement; MATERIAL_IMPROVEMENT requires a frozen common decision-treatment change.
closed_findings.acceptance_criterion: Synchronized label/output forgery, wrong settlement identity, duplicate cells, unavailable fields, mixed plus scope, same direction plus scope and group/product reversal all replay to the predeclared treatment.

residual_risks: The result phase must supply a settlement replayed from the existing canonical control plane; a caller-constructed object has no canonical authority.
One scope event may appear in permanent-loss and strongest-rival views, but the readout must treat the shared decision-treatment change as one finding rather than two method wins.
One historical sample remains CANDIDATE_ONLY and cannot prove transfer, real-time forecasting or investment utility.
Unavailable real fields must remain UNKNOWN or MEASUREMENT_MISMATCH without supplementary search or rule revision.
